paite: "Na diktatna nasepte uh mite ma a, mihing mitmuh ding a hih lou ding in pilvang un; huchi lou in zaw na Pa uh van a om kiang ah kipahman na nei kei ding uh.
heading: Aguk A Thilpiak
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

paite: "Huchi in mi kiang a thilpiak na piak in, milepchiahte'n mite phat alohtheihna ding ua sinagogte leh kongzing a ahih nak bang un na ma uah pengkul mut kei un. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amaute'n apahtakman uh angahta uh.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

paite: Nang zaw mi kiang a thilpiak na piak in, na khut taklam in ahih na khut veilam in thei kei hen;
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

paite: na thilpiak aguk ahihtheihna ding in. Huchi in na Pa aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

paite: "Huan na thum chiang un milepchiahte bang in na hih ding uh ahi kei; mi'n amuhtheihna ding un, sinagogte leh kongzing kathuam laitak khawng ah dingh kawm a thum a-ut se uhi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amaute'n apahtakman uh angahta uh.
heading: Aguk A Thumna
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

paite: Nang zaw na thum chiang in, na dantan sunggil a lut in, na kongkhak khak inla, na Pa aguk a om kiang ah thum in. Huchi in na Pa aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

paite: "Huan na thum un, Zentelte bang in gentuan mawkmawk kei un; apau tam ziak ua zak a om ding akisa uhi.
english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute bang in om kei un, amah na nget ma ua na Pa un bangbang ahia na poimoh uh theigige ahi.”
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

paite: Huchi in nou zaw hichibang in thum un: "Ka Pa uh van a om, na min kizahtak hen.
heading: Toupa Thumna / (Luk 11.2-4)
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

paite: Na gam hong tung hen. Na deihlam van a akihih bang in, lei ah leng kihih hen.
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

paite: Niteng ka nek khop uh an hon pia in.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

paite: Ka tung ua khialte ka ngaihdam bang un, nang leng ka khelhna uh hon ngaidam in.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

paite: Khemna ah hon pilut ke'nla, gilou lak ah hon hu zaw in, lalgam leh thilbawltheihna leh thupina Tangtawn a nang a ahih ziak in, Amen," chi in.
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

paite: "Mi atatleknate uh na ngaihdam uleh, na Pa uh van a om in leng hon ngaidam sam ding hi.
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

paite: Himahleh mite tatleknate na ngaihdam kei ngal un, na Pa un na tatleknate uh angaidam sam kei ding hi.
english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

paite: "An na ngolh un leng, milepchiahte bang in nguimel pu kei un; amau zaw mite mitmuh a an ngawl a akilat theihna ding un, amel uh anguisak nak uhi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, apahtakman uh angahta uhi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Thuhilhna
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

paite: Nou zaw, an na ngolh chiang un na lu uh sathau nilh unla, na mai uh phiat un.
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

paite: Huchi in na Pa uh aguk a om mitmuh lou ngal ah mihing mitmuh in an ngawl na bang kei ding ua; huchi in na Pa uh aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

paite: "Lei a, leikha leh tui-ek in aneksiatna ah, gutate'n phenvang a agukna uah gou kikhol kei un.
heading: Hauhna Dik / (Luk 12.33-34)
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

paite: Van ah, leikha leh tui-ek in aneksiatlouhna ah, gutate'n aphen ua aguklouhna uah, gou kikhol zaw un.
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

paite: Na gou omna peuh uah na lungtang uh leng a-om ding hi.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

paite: "Pumpi khawnvak mit ahi; huchi a na mit achimleh avek in na pumpi atansuak ding hi.
heading: Pumpi Khawnvak / (Luk 11.34-36)
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

paite: Na mit asiatleh na pumpi avek in amial khin vek ding. Huchi in na sung a vak om pen mial hileh nak mial na tel in chia!
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

paite: "Kuamah in heutu nih nna asemkop thei kei; khat hua in khat a-it ding; ahihkeileh, khat gum in khat asimmoh ding. Pathian leh sum nna na semkop thei kei ding uh.
heading: Lunghihmohna A Pathian Muanna
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi. Bang ahia ka nek ding, bang ahia ka dawn ding, chi in na hinna thu uh leh; bang ahia ka silh ding, bang ahia ka ten ding, chi in na pumpi thu uh lunghimoh kei un. Nek ding sang in hinna athupizaw kei a hia? Silh-leten sang in pumpi leng athupizaw kei a hia?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

paite: Tungleng vasate en un; buh atuh kei ua, a-at kei uh, buh inn ah leng aseklut sam kei uh. Himahleh na Pa uh van a om in amaute avak hi. Noute amau sang a nakpitak a manphazaw hilou na hi uh maw?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

paite: Huan noute lak ah lunghihmoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

paite: "Huan silh-le-ten thu bang ding a lunghimoh na hi ua? Gamlak lili pak khandan hoihtak in ngaihtuah un; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh.
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

paite: Himahleh, ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in hiai lili pak khat bang in zep in a-om kei hi.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

paite: Huchi in gamlak loupa, tuni a hing a, azing a thuk a khul mai ding bawn Pathian in huchi lawmlawm a azepleh, aw nou gintawmte, silh-le-ten ding hon pe tawk na lou ding hiam?
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

paite: "Huchi in bang ahia i nek ding, ahihkeileh bang ahia i dawn ding? Ahihkeileh bang silh in ahia i om ding chi in lunghimoh kei un.
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

paite: Zentelte'n huai tengteng azong uhi. Hiaite tengteng na poimoh uh chih na Pa uh van a om in theigige ahi.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

paite: Agam leh ama diktatna zong masa un, huchi in hiaite tengteng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

paite: "Huchi in azing a ding lunghimoh kei un; azing in amah a ding akilunghimoh tawm ding ziak in. Ni khat a ding in ni khat buaina ahun lel hi.”
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
